label: AB_hP4_186_b_a-001
title: Original BN ($B12$) Structure ({\em Obsolete})
comments:
This is the BN structure found in (Ewald, 1931) p. 95 and (Wilson, 1961) pp. 125-126. (Pease, 1950) later determined that the true boron nitride structure is what is now known as the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB_hP4_194_c_d-001}{$B_{k}$} structure. We leave this structure here for historical reasons. It is crystallographically equivalent to, and hence a binary representation of, the \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_186_ab-001}{buckled graphite structure}. 
 Space group $P6_{3}$ \#186 is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SpaceGroupDistribution#Polar}{polar}, so there is no fixed origin for the $z$ axis. Here we chose $z_{1} = 0$ for the boron (2a) site.
